name: Stair Running
steps: Stand at the base of a clean, well-lit flight of stairs in an athletic ready stance with knees slightly bent.
Lean slightly forward from your ankles, pump your arms briskly, and drive explosively up the steps on your forefeet.
Maintain quick, rhythmic alternating foot strikes while lifting your knees cleanly to clear every step.
Walk calmly and carefully back down to recover between climbs and continue for the target duration or distance.
tips: Keep your eyes on the upcoming steps and plant your midfoot securely on each tread.
Walk down gently to protect your knees and ankles rather than sprinting downward.
